# Design System Inspired by Cursor

A minimal fixture used by execute-bridge tests to exercise
`readRepoDesignProfile()` without depending on a sibling repo on the
contributor's machine.

## Tone

- Dark, focused, no chrome.
- Monospaced for code, system sans for everything else.

## Palette

- Background: near-black with subtle warm tint.
- Accent: cool blue, used sparingly.
